readout_other: Neurological severity score (NSS), elevated body swing test (EBST), corner test; cresyl violet infarct/atrophy volume; IBA1/CD16-32/arginase/IL-10R immunostaining; flow cytometry (FACS) for M1/M2 microglia; Western blot for IL-10R; RT-PCR for IL-10 and IL-10R mRNA
direction_notes: Study assessed therapeutic/behavioural and anti-inflammatory outcomes (reduced infarct volume, improved NSS/EBST/corner test, increased M2 microglia and IL-10/IL-10R) rather than excitatory/inhibitory direction of neural activity.

exposures.label: tFUS to ischemic hemisphere after MCAO

target.label: ischemic hemisphere (selected region of the cortex)

device.manufacturer: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

timing.protocol_description: tFUS was delivered with a portable ultrasound stimulation system to the selected cortical region of the ischemic hemisphere; the stimulation sequence used a toneburst-duration (TBD), pulse repetition frequency (PRF), sonication duration (SD) and 2.7 s inter-stimuli interval (ISI) as illustrated in Fig. 2D. Beginning 7 days after MCAO, ultrasound stimulation was performed for 10 minutes per day over 7 consecutive days, totaling 360 trials of ultrasound stimulation.

source_quotes.n_subjects: MCAO/ultra-group, n=18 for behavioral test, infarct volume evaluation, immunostaining, flow cytometry, Western blot and PCR analysis.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Seven days following MCAO, ultrasound stimulation was performed for 10 minutes per day over 7 consecutive days.

flags.reason: Paper does not state whether the reported Isppa (120 mW/cm2) is a free-field or in-situ value; placed in unspecified_domain.
Duty cycle is not stated explicitly; arithmetic from pulse duration (0.5 ms) and PRF (1000 Hz) would suggest 50% but this is not computed per instructions.
Only an untreated MCAO-alone control group is described; no sham ultrasound (e.g. inactive transducer) arm was used.
